title: A closed subset of a Noetherian scheme has finitely many irreducible components
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], and let $E\subseteq X$ be a closed subset. Then $E$ is the union of finitely many irreducible components, where irreducible components are maximal irreducible closed subsets of $E$ [def-weil-irreducible-components].

source.place: Properties Lemma 0BA8 (properties-lemma-Noetherian-irreducible-components), applied to the closed subspace E
